title: $k$-criticality of the graphs in the Mycielski tower
statement: For every integer $k \ge 2$, the graph $G_k$ in the Mycielski tower is $k$-critical: its chromatic number is $\chi(G_k) = k$, and it is critical, meaning that every proper subgraph $H \subsetneq G_k$ satisfies $\chi(H) < \chi(G_k)$.
hypotheses_covered: the graph is the $k$-th member $G_k$ of the Mycielski tower
replaced:
